comment: shk.c same_price() report for two unpaid stacks on no bill. Seed 8452217's Dlvl 4 has a weapon shop whose keeper stands at (54,5) inside an open door at (53,5); a debug-mode Samurai who level-teleports there lands at (58,3) on 10 darts (port-only scanSeeds() probe over 8452000-8452400 for a hero who lands on an object inside a shop with its keeper at home: 16 hits, this one chosen for its weapon shop). He picks up the darts (unpaid), hurls the keeper west through the door with #wiztelekinesis (wizcmds.c wiz_telekinesis() -> mhurtle()), wishes for a hole under himself (objnam.c wizterrainwish()) and plunges through it with '>'. shk.c u_left_shop() returns early because the keeper is not inhishop(), so the darts stay unpaid on Dlvl 5, where no bill holds them. He throws one dart down with 't' and '>': mkobj.c splitobj() reaches shk.c splitbill(), which reports "splitbill: no resident shopkeeper??", and dothrow.c hitfloor() names the dart (unpaid_cost()'s report). Picking it up again with ',' makes invent.c addinv_core0() try merged() against the other nine; mergable() calls shk.c same_price(), which finds neither stack on a bill and reports "same_price: object wasn't on any bill!" (977) before prinv() names the dart. The port plans the pickup's merges in advance (invent.js preflight_addinv_sequence()); that plan must not print the report a second time. Seed, datetime, character and inputs were chosen independently of every recorded session and batch game.
